summary: Lower for-await-of using JavaScript async-iterator lookup, synchronous-iterator fallback, per-step awaiting, and iterator close semantics.

target.notes: Prefer Symbol.asyncIterator; if absent, wrap Symbol.iterator via Async-from-Sync Iterator. Abrupt loop completion must perform iterator close/return.

semantics.lookup: async iterator first, sync iterator fallback
semantics.value: iterator result value follows async-from-sync semantics

caveats: IAsyncEnumerable alone does not model JS synchronous-iterator fallback or arbitrary iterator result objects.
Dynamic Symbol.asyncIterator/Symbol.iterator getters require runtime handling.

tests.name: sync iterable fallback
tests.input: async function f(){for await(const x of [1,2])console.log(x)} f();

tests.name: break closes async iterator
tests.input: const it={i:0,[Symbol.asyncIterator](){return this},next(){return Promise.resolve({value:++this.i,done:false})},return(){console.log('closed');return Promise.resolve({done:true})}};(async()=>{for await(const x of it){break}})();
